title: Class maps and proof certificates
objective: Implement abstract class-group presentation/maps, ideal discrete logarithms, principality witnesses, GRH proof labels, unconditional Minkowski proof records, and mutation tests

handoff.summary: Adds a CPython-parseable IdealClassGroup with Sage-compatible invariant coordinates, generator ideals and exact orders, multiplicative class elements, bidirectional arbitrary fractional-ideal maps, exact quotient discrete-log witnesses, and witnessed principality results. The new class_group_from_engine_result adapter consumes a completed engine presentation, reconstructs and verifies Smith-generator order witnesses, validates presentation order/free rank and proof-stage counts, and attaches independently replayable serialized GRH or unconditional Minkowski evidence. Minkowski replay regenerates the complete exact prime stream and rechecks factored principal generators; focused tests cover genuine Sage.js fractional ideals and payload/presentation corruption.
risks: The adapter applies to relation-engine results that retain an exact presentation and ideal discrete-log witnesses; specialized legacy results without ideal maps deliberately remain on their existing fallback surface.
Independent unconditional replay regenerates every prime ideal through the certified Minkowski bound, so verification cost is proportional to that proof bound.
The broad pnpm test:baselib:strict and pnpm test:native contract gates were deferred to central integration by coordinator direction; focused compiled and standalone strict-Pyright receipts pass.
next_steps: Wire class_group_from_engine_result(result) into the public class_group projection with a lazy import and preserve the legacy result group when the adapter reports that exact map material is unavailable.
Add an integration smoke test around one completed general Buchmann--Hecke engine result once engine and map lanes are merged.
Run the broad strict/native and four-platform gates after all class/unit lanes are merged, then move this contract from active to review if lane policy requires those receipts.
